decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 6th October 2014 and numbered 2913.14.1 and location plan, and 18th November 2014 and numbered 2913.14.4 (REV A) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be use at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling known as 2 Hazelmere Close, Feltham.
description: Demolition of a detached garage and reconstruction of a single storey outbuilding as a detached garage to the side of the house
